bio.text: Marie Pinkney has represented the 13th District in the Delaware Senate since 2020, when she became the first African American LGBTQ+ person elected to the Delaware Senate.

Pinkney was raised in Wilmington and New Castle, earned a bachelor's degree in social work from Norfolk State University and a master's in social work from Delaware State University, and lives in Bear.
Pinkney worked as a social worker and case manager at ChristianaCare until 2024, then left to pursue a second master's degree in Africana Studies at the University of Delaware.
